$comment: Data-dependents registry (plan `consistency`, 2026-11-20). One entry per data source: the files that trigger it, the consumers computed from it (confirm they still look right), the typed restatements that must be edited by hand, and the commands to run. scripts/notify_dependents.mjs prints an entry when one of its triggers is edited (PostToolUse hook) or changed on a branch (`npm run dependents`). `<slug>` is filled in with the school being edited. Adding a new derived consumer of a source means adding it here in the same PR.
